paragraphs: By leveraging AI to connect marketers with their ideal audiences, Quantcast's mission aligns with my experience in developing and deploying machine learning models. I contributed to projects using scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, which were deployed as FastAPI services in Docker. This hands-on experience in building robust models and services directly supports Quantcast's technological advancements.

Additionally, I developed an XGBoost churn classifier in R using tidymodels, incorporating a two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE within the recipe, and evaluating with Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC). This project showcased my ability to handle complex model tuning and evaluation processes.
I have not used Python's FastAPI for deployment yet, but I am eager to learn and apply it in my future work.

Could we schedule a call to discuss how my background in building and deploying machine learning models could contribute to Quantcast's mission? I would be happy to walk you through my projects and how they align with your needs.
